candidates.description: This vector represents active verb lemmas and their inflected forms denoting various physical, mental, or social actions and states.
This feature activates common English conjunctions, prepositions, and transition words frequently used at the beginning of clauses.
This vector activates strongly for second- and third-person possessive pronouns and definite articles, particularly involving archaic or shortened forms.
This feature vector activates strongly on punctuation marks, particularly quotation marks and closing parentheses combined with various forms of punctuation.
This vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "ant" appearing as a suffix, root, or component within words.
This feature vector represents grammatical conjunctions, relative pronouns, and interrogative words across multiple languages.
These tokens represent Roman numerals in various cases and formats.
Demonstrative determiners and pronouns across multiple languages.
This vector represents terms related to flowers, sweets, and luxury items often associated with gifting and indulgence.
This vector activates for tokens containing the phonetic sound "am" or variations of the letters "am".
